about:
Belmont Market has operated in Wakefield, Rhode Island, since 1947. The family-owned grocery business began as a local market and has expanded to include multiple departments and services.

The market operates a full-service grocery store with departments spanning deli, floral, grocery, health and wellness, meat, prepared foods, produce, seafood, and sushi. Its kitchen prepares meals fresh daily, and the company assembles gift baskets and offers catering for events. Online ordering supports home delivery across Washington County and Jamestown, with curbside pickup available.

Belmont Market serves retail consumers and local event hosts seeking catering, gift baskets, and prepared meals. Its wholesale program supplies local businesses, and the rewards program targets repeat shoppers in the surrounding community.

The company emphasizes local sourcing where possible and promotes a "fresh from our family to yours" ethos, positioning itself as a community-focused alternative to larger chains.
